snippet.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct 9.8.2026
snippet.description:
Adventure through Hyrule and become the Hero of Time when The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time releases November 5, 2026, on Nintendo Switch 2. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1036-01&utm_id=S1036-01

Physical version of the game with special textured foil packaging will be available at launch while supplies last.

#NintendoDirect #TheLegendOfZelda #OcarinaOfTime

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
